title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Surcharge Uplift by Trade Lane
content:
## Clause

The route of the goods also shapes the Dangerous Goods Acceptance loading surcharge. The trade lane recorded on the acceptance brings its own uplift percentage, and the schedule is identical in all six categories.

## Lane schedule (percent, every category)

| Trade lane | Uplift |
|---|---|
| Transpacific Eastbound | 20 |
| Asia–US East Coast | 20 |
| Transatlantic Westbound | 15 |
| Asia–Middle East–India | 10 |
| Europe–South America East Coast | 10 |
| Asia–North Europe | 0 |
| Asia–Mediterranean | 0 |
| Intra-Asia | 0 |

## Points of judgement

**Does the category change the lane uplift?** No. An acceptance of AHL DG Limited Quantity and one of AHL DG Special Approval on the Transatlantic Westbound lane both take 15.

**Which lane is read?** The lane on the acceptance record.
